<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<interface>
  <template class="BustleAddressDialog" parent="AdwAlertDialog">
    <property name="heading" translatable="yes">Record Address</property>
    <property name="body-use-markup">True</property>
    <property name="default-response">record</property>
    <property name="close-response">cancel</property>
    <responses>
      <response id="cancel" translatable="yes">_Cancel</response>
      <response id="record" translatable="yes" appearance="suggested">_Record</response>
    </responses>
    <property name="extra-child">
      <object class="GtkListBox">
        <style>
          <class name="boxed-list"/>
        </style>
        <child>
          <object class="AdwEntryRow" id="entry_row">
            <property name="title" translatable="yes">Server Address</property>
            <signal name="changed" handler="update_record_response_enabled" swapped="yes"/>
          </object>
        </child>
      </object>
    </property>
  </template>
</interface>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<interface>
  <template class="BustleDetailsView">
    <child>
      <object class="GtkScrolledWindow" id="scrolled_window">
        <property name="hscrollbar-policy">never</property>
        <property name="child">
          <object class="GtkBox">
            <property name="margin-start">18</property>
            <property name="margin-end">18</property>
            <property name="margin-top">18</property>
            <property name="margin-bottom">18</property>
            <property name="orientation">vertical</property>
            <property name="spacing">18</property>
            <child>
              <object class="AdwPreferencesGroup" id="associated_message_group">
                <child>
                  <object class="AdwButtonRow">
                    <property name="title" translatable="yes">Associated Message</property>
                    <signal name="activated" handler="associated_message_activated" swapped="yes"/>
                    <property name="end-icon-name">go-next-symbolic</property>
                  </object>
                </child>
              </object>
            </child>
            <child>
              <object class="AdwPreferencesGroup" id="copy_as_busctl_group">
                <child>
                  <object class="AdwButtonRow">
                    <property name="title" translatable="yes">Copy as busctl</property>
                    <property name="end-icon-name">edit-copy-symbolic</property>
                    <signal name="activated" handler="copy_as_busctl_activated" swapped="yes"/>
                  </object>
                </child>
              </object>
            </child>
            <child>
              <object class="AdwPreferencesGroup">
                <property name="title" translatable="yes">Message</property>
                <child>
                  <object class="AdwActionRow" id="type_row">
                    <property name="title" translatable="yes">Type</property>
                    <property name="subtitle-selectable">True</property>
                    <style>
                      <class name="property"/>
                    </style>
                  </object>
                </child>
                <child>
                  <object class="AdwActionRow" id="path_row">
                    <property name="title" translatable="yes">Path</property>
                    <property name="subtitle-selectable">True</property>
                    <style>
                      <class name="property"/>
                    </style>
                  </object>
                </child>
                <child>
                  <object class="AdwActionRow" id="interface_row">
                    <property name="title" translatable="yes">Interface</property>
                    <property name="subtitle-selectable">True</property>
                    <style>
                      <class name="property"/>
                    </style>
                  </object>
                </child>
                <child>
                  <object class="AdwActionRow" id="member_row">
                    <property name="title" translatable="yes">Member</property>
                    <property name="subtitle-selectable">True</property>
                    <style>
                      <class name="property"/>
                    </style>
                  </object>
                </child>
                <child>
                  <object class="AdwActionRow" id="error_row">
                    <property name="title" translatable="yes">Error Type</property>
                    <property name="visible">False</property>
                    <property name="subtitle-selectable">True</property>
                    <style>
                      <class name="property"/>
                    </style>
                  </object>
                </child>
              </object>
            </child>
            <child>
              <object class="AdwPreferencesGroup">
                <property name="title" translatable="yes">Details</property>
                <child>
                  <object class="AdwActionRow" id="sender_row">
                    <property name="title" translatable="yes">Sender</property>
                    <property name="subtitle-selectable">True</property>
                    <style>
                      <class name="property"/>
                    </style>
                  </object>
                </child>
                <child>
                  <object class="AdwActionRow" id="destination_row">
                    <property name="title" translatable="yes">Destination</property>
                    <property name="subtitle-selectable">True</property>
                    <style>
                      <class name="property"/>
                    </style>
                  </object>
                </child>
                <child>
                  <object class="AdwActionRow" id="component_row">
                    <property name="title" translatable="yes">Component</property>
                    <property name="subtitle-selectable">True</property>
                    <child type="suffix">
                      <object class="BustleColorWidget" id="component_color">
                        <property name="halign">center</property>
                        <property name="valign">center</property>
                      </object>
                    </child>
                    <style>
                      <class name="property"/>
                    </style>
                  </object>
                </child>
                <child>
                  <object class="AdwActionRow" id="size_row">
                    <property name="title" translatable="yes">Body Size</property>
                    <property name="subtitle-selectable">True</property>
                    <style>
                      <class name="property"/>
                      <class name="numeric"/>
                    </style>
                  </object>
                </child>
                <child>
                  <object class="AdwActionRow" id="response_time_row">
                    <property name="title" translatable="yes">Response Time</property>
                    <property name="subtitle-selectable">True</property>
                    <style>
                      <class name="property"/>
                      <class name="numeric"/>
                    </style>
                  </object>
                </child>
                <child>
                  <object class="AdwActionRow" id="signature_row">
                    <property name="title" translatable="yes">Signature</property>
                    <property name="subtitle-selectable">True</property>
                    <style>
                      <class name="property"/>
                    </style>
                  </object>
                </child>
                <child>
                  <object class="AdwActionRow" id="flags_row">
                    <property name="title" translatable="yes">Flags</property>
                    <property name="subtitle-selectable">True</property>
                    <style>
                      <class name="property"/>
                    </style>
                  </object>
                </child>
              </object>
            </child>
            <child>
              <object class="AdwPreferencesGroup" id="body_group">
                <property name="title" translatable="yes">Body</property>
                <property name="header-suffix">
                  <object class="GtkButton">
                    <property name="tooltip-text" translatable="yes">Open Format Documentation</property>
                    <property name="icon-name">question-round-outline-symbolic</property>
                    <signal name="clicked" handler="open_doc_button_clicked" swapped="yes"/>
                    <style>
                      <class name="flat"/>
                    </style>
                  </object>
                </property>
                <child>
                  <object class="GtkScrolledWindow">
                    <property name="min-content-height">180</property>
                    <property name="overflow">hidden</property>
                    <property name="child">
                      <object class="GtkTextView">
                        <property name="top-margin">12</property>
                        <property name="bottom-margin">12</property>
                        <property name="left-margin">12</property>
                        <property name="right-margin">12</property>
                        <property name="editable">False</property>
                        <property name="cursor-visible">False</property>
                        <property name="wrap-mode">word</property>
                        <property name="buffer">
                          <object class="GtkTextBuffer" id="arguments_text_buffer"/>
                        </property>
                        <accessibility>
                          <relation name="labelled-by">body_group</relation>
                        </accessibility>
                      </object>
                    </property>
                    <style>
                      <class name="card"/>
                      <class name="arguments-view"/>
                    </style>
                  </object>
                </child>
              </object>
            </child>
          </object>
        </property>
      </object>
    </child>
  </template>
</interface>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<interface>
  <template class="BustleDiagram">
    <child>
      <object class="BustleDiagramHeader" id="header"/>
    </child>
    <child>
      <object class="GtkSeparator" id="separator"/>
    </child>
    <child>
      <object class="GtkScrolledWindow" id="scrolled_window">
        <property name="vexpand">True</property>
        <property name="child">
          <object class="BustleDiagramView" id="view">
            <signal name="notify::selected-message" handler="view_selected_message_notify" swapped="yes"/>
          </object>
        </property>
      </object>
    </child>
  </template>
</interface>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<interface>
  <template class="BustleDiagramHeader">
    <property name="overflow">hidden</property>
    <child>
      <object class="GtkGestureClick">
        <signal name="released" handler="gesture_click_released" swapped="yes"/>
      </object>
    </child>
    <child>
      <object class="GtkImage" id="arrow">
        <property name="margin-end">3</property>
        <property name="margin-start">3</property>
        <property name="margin-top">3</property>
        <property name="margin-bottom">3</property>
        <property name="halign">start</property>
        <property name="valign">start</property>
        <property name="icon-name">expander-arrow-symbolic</property>
        <property name="accessible-role">presentation</property>
        <property name="tooltip-text" translatable="yes">Expand</property>
        <style>
          <class name="diagram-header-arrow"/>
          <class name="dimmed"/>
        </style>
      </object>
    </child>
  </template>
</interface>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<interface>
  <template class="BustleDiagramRow">
    <property name="margin-top">6</property>
    <property name="margin-bottom">6</property>
    <child>
      <object class="GtkLabel" id="timestamp_label">
        <property name="xalign">0</property>
        <property name="width-chars">8</property>
        <style>
          <class name="caption"/>
          <class name="numeric"/>
        </style>
      </object>
    </child>
    <child>
      <object class="BustleDiagramRowTag" id="tag"/>
    </child>
    <child>
      <object class="GtkBox" id="vbox">
        <property name="orientation">vertical</property>
        <property name="valign">center</property>
        <child>
          <object class="GtkLabel" id="title_label">
            <property name="xalign">0</property>
            <property name="max-width-chars">48</property>
            <property name="ellipsize">start</property>
            <style>
              <class name="caption"/>
            </style>
          </object>
        </child>
        <child>
          <object class="GtkLabel" id="subtitle_label">
            <property name="xalign">0</property>
            <property name="max-width-chars">48</property>
            <property name="ellipsize">start</property>
            <style>
              <class name="caption"/>
            </style>
          </object>
        </child>
      </object>
    </child>
  </template>
</interface>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<interface>
  <template class="BustleDiagramRowTag">
    <child>
      <object class="BustleColorWidget" id="color">
        <property name="halign">center</property>
        <property name="valign">center</property>
      </object>
    </child>
    <child>
      <object class="GtkInscription" id="label">
        <property name="xalign">0</property>
        <property name="text-overflow">ellipsize-end</property>
        <property name="nat-chars">15</property>
        <style>
          <class name="caption"/>
        </style>
      </object>
    </child>
  </template>
</interface>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<interface>
  <template class="BustleDiagramView">
    <property name="overflow">hidden</property>
    <child>
      <object class="GtkListView" id="list_view">
        <property name="factory">
          <object class="GtkSignalListItemFactory">
            <signal name="setup" handler="factory_setup" swapped="yes"/>
            <signal name="teardown" handler="factory_teardown" swapped="yes"/>
            <signal name="bind" handler="factory_bind" swapped="yes"/>
            <signal name="unbind" handler="factory_unbind" swapped="yes"/>
          </object>
        </property>
        <property name="model">
          <object class="GtkSingleSelection" id="selection_model">
            <property name="can-unselect">True</property>
            <property name="autoselect">False</property>
            <signal name="notify::selected-item" handler="selection_model_selected_item_notify" swapped="yes"/>
          </object>
        </property>
        <style>
          <class name="navigation-sidebar"/>
        </style>
      </object>
    </child>
  </template>
</interface>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<interface>
  <template class="BustleDurationsPage" parent="AdwBin">
    <child>
      <object class="GtkScrolledWindow">
        <child>
          <object class="GtkColumnView" id="column_view">
            <property name="show-column-separators">True</property>
            <property name="show-row-separators">True</property>
            <accessibility>
              <property name="label" translatable="yes">Durations</property>
              <property name="description" translatable="yes">The total and mean time every method call took</property>
            </accessibility>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkColumnViewColumn" id="method_column">
                <property name="title" translatable="yes">Method</property>
                <property name="expand">True</property>
                <property name="factory">
                  <object class="GtkBuilderListItemFactory">
                    <property name="bytes"><![CDATA[
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<interface>
  <template class="GtkListItem">
    <property name="child">
      <object class="GtkLabel">
        <property name="halign">end</property>
        <property name="use-markup">True</property>
        <binding name="label">
          <lookup name="method" type="BustleDurationItem">
            <lookup name="item">GtkListItem</lookup>
          </lookup>
        </binding>
      </object>
    </property>
  </template>
</interface>
]]>
                    </property>
                  </object>
                </property>
              </object>
            </child>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkColumnViewColumn" id="total_column">
                <property name="title" translatable="yes">Total</property>
                <property name="factory">
                  <object class="GtkBuilderListItemFactory">
                    <property name="bytes">
                      <![CDATA[
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<interface>
  <template class="GtkListItem">
    <property name="child">
      <object class="GtkInscription">
        <property name="min-chars">12</property>
        <binding name="text">
          <closure type="gchararray" function="total_duration">
            <lookup name="item">GtkListItem</lookup>
          </closure>
        </binding>
        <style>
          <class name="numeric" />
        </style>
      </object>
    </property>
  </template>
</interface>
]]>
                    </property>
                  </object>
                </property>
              </object>
            </child>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkColumnViewColumn" id="calls_column">
                <property name="title" translatable="yes">Calls</property>
                <property name="factory">
                  <object class="GtkBuilderListItemFactory">
                    <property name="bytes"><![CDATA[
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<interface>
  <template class="GtkListItem">
    <property name="child">
      <object class="BustleProgressCell">
        <binding name="text">
          <lookup name="calls" type="BustleDurationItem">
            <lookup name="item">GtkListItem</lookup>
          </lookup>
        </binding>
        <binding name="fraction">
          <closure type="gdouble" function="calls_fraction">
            <lookup name="item">GtkListItem</lookup>
          </closure>
        </binding>
        <accessibility>
          <property name="label" translatable="yes">Calls</property>
        </accessibility>
      </object>
    </property>
  </template>
</interface>
]]>
                    </property>
                  </object>
                </property>
              </object>
            </child>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkColumnViewColumn" id="mean_column">
                <property name="title" translatable="yes">Mean</property>
                <property name="factory">
                  <object class="GtkBuilderListItemFactory">
                    <property name="bytes">
                      <![CDATA[
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<interface>
  <template class="GtkListItem">
    <property name="child">
      <object class="GtkInscription">
        <property name="min-chars">12</property>
        <binding name="text">
          <closure type="gchararray" function="mean_duration">
            <lookup name="item">GtkListItem</lookup>
          </closure>
        </binding>
        <style>
          <class name="numeric" />
        </style>
      </object>
    </property>
  </template>
</interface>
]]>
                    </property>
                  </object>
                </property>
              </object>
            </child>
            <style>
              <class name="data-table" />
            </style>
          </object>
        </child>
      </object>
    </child>
  </template>
</interface>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<interface>
  <menu id="actions-menu">
    <section>
      <item>
        <attribute name="label" translatable="yes">Select All Tags</attribute>
        <attribute name="action">filter-pane.select-all-message-tags</attribute>
      </item>
      <item>
        <attribute name="label" translatable="yes">Unselect All Tags</attribute>
        <attribute name="action">filter-pane.unselect-all-message-tags</attribute>
      </item>
    </section>
    <section>
      <item>
        <attribute name="label" translatable="yes">Select All Names</attribute>
        <attribute name="action">filter-pane.select-all-bus-names</attribute>
      </item>
      <item>
        <attribute name="label" translatable="yes">Unselect All Names</attribute>
        <attribute name="action">filter-pane.unselect-all-bus-names</attribute>
      </item>
    </section>
  </menu>
  <template class="BustleFilterPane">
    <child>
      <object class="AdwToolbarView" id="toolbar_view">
        <child>
          <object class="GtkBox">
            <property name="orientation">vertical</property>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkScrolledWindow">
                <property name="vexpand">True</property>
                <property name="hscrollbar-policy">never</property>
                <property name="child">
                  <object class="GtkListBox" id="message_tag_list_box">
                    <property name="selection-mode">none</property>
                    <signal name="row-activated" handler="message_tag_list_box_row_activated" swapped="yes"/>
                    <style>
                      <class name="navigation-sidebar"/>
                    </style>
                  </object>
                </property>
              </object>
            </child>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkSeparator"/>
            </child>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkScrolledWindow">
                <property name="vexpand">True</property>
                <property name="hscrollbar-policy">never</property>
                <property name="child">
                  <object class="GtkListBox" id="bus_name_list_box">
                    <property name="selection-mode">none</property>
                    <signal name="row-activated" handler="bus_name_list_box_row_activated" swapped="yes"/>
                    <style>
                      <class name="navigation-sidebar"/>
                    </style>
                  </object>
                </property>
              </object>
            </child>
          </object>
        </child>
        <child type="bottom">
          <object class="AdwBin">
            <style>
              <class name="toolbar"/>
            </style>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkMenuButton">
                <property name="label" translatable="yes">Actions</property>
                <property name="menu-model">actions-menu</property>
                <property name="can-shrink">True</property>
              </object>
            </child>
          </object>
        </child>
      </object>
    </child>
  </template>
</interface>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<interface>
  <template class="BustleFilterPaneBusNameRow" parent="GtkListBoxRow">
    <property name="selectable">False</property>
    <property name="child">
      <object class="GtkBox">
        <property name="spacing">12</property>
        <child>
          <object class="GtkBox">
            <property name="orientation">vertical</property>
            <property name="hexpand">True</property>
            <property name="valign">center</property>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkLabel" id="title">
                <property name="xalign">0</property>
                <property name="ellipsize">end</property>
                <style>
                  <class name="caption-heading"/>
                </style>
              </object>
            </child>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkLabel" id="subtitle">
                <property name="xalign">0</property>
                <property name="hexpand">True</property>
                <property name="wrap">True</property>
                <style>
                  <class name="caption"/>
                </style>
              </object>
            </child>
          </object>
        </child>
        <child>
          <object class="GtkCheckButton" id="check_button">
            <property name="active">True</property>
            <style>
              <class name="selection-mode"/>
            </style>
            <accessibility>
              <relation name="labelled-by">title</relation>
            </accessibility>
          </object>
        </child>
      </object>
    </property>
    <style>
      <class name="filter-pane-row"/>
    </style>
  </template>
</interface>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<interface>
  <template class="BustleFrequenciesPage" parent="AdwBin">
    <child>
      <object class="GtkScrolledWindow">
        <child>
          <object class="GtkColumnView" id="column_view">
            <property name="show-column-separators">True</property>
            <property name="show-row-separators">True</property>
            <accessibility>
              <property name="label" translatable="yes">Frequencies</property>
              <property name="description" translatable="yes">The frequencies of method calls and signals</property>
            </accessibility>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkColumnViewColumn" id="message_type_column">
                <property name="title" translatable="yes">Message Type</property>
                <property name="factory">
                  <object class="GtkBuilderListItemFactory">
                    <property name="bytes"><![CDATA[
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<interface>
  <template class="GtkListItem">
    <property name="child">
      <object class="GtkInscription">
        <property name="min-chars">13</property>
        <binding name="text">
          <closure type="gchararray" function="message_type">
            <lookup name="item">GtkListItem</lookup>
          </closure>
        </binding>
      </object>
    </property>
  </template>
</interface>
]]>
                    </property>
                  </object>
                </property>
              </object>
            </child>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkColumnViewColumn" id="member_column">
                <property name="expand">True</property>
                <property name="title" translatable="yes">Member</property>
                <property name="factory">
                  <object class="GtkBuilderListItemFactory">
                    <property name="bytes"><![CDATA[
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<interface>
  <template class="GtkListItem">
    <property name="child">
      <object class="GtkLabel">
        <property name="halign">end</property>
        <property name="use-markup">True</property>
        <binding name="label">
          <lookup name="member" type="BustleFrequencyItem">
            <lookup name="item">GtkListItem</lookup>
          </lookup>
        </binding>
      </object>
    </property>
  </template>
</interface>
]]>
                    </property>
                  </object>
                </property>
              </object>
            </child>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkColumnViewColumn" id="frequency_column">
                <property name="title" translatable="yes">Frequency</property>
                <property name="factory">
                  <object class="GtkBuilderListItemFactory">
